$comment: Content-script budget from docs/tech-stack.md section 6 (the observer and the card are unlisted scripts built to observer.js and explain-card.js at the package root) (D-08, raised to 18 KB by D-20). KB means 1024 bytes. Sizes are gzip level 9 of each built file. The toolbar (Preact) is injected on the first selection with its own 18 KB gzip budget; the explanation card loads separately (Phase 5) with its own budget. Reader and side panel page budgets follow static JavaScript imports from the entry chunk, ignoring dynamic imports. Reader lazy UI follows the toolbar and explanation chunks, then subtracts the startup closure so shared chunks are charged only to startup. Hashed chunk names come from the bundler; patterns match by prefix. maxZipBytes (3.2 MB) caps the store ZIP and maxUnpackedBytes (7 MiB; the 1.0.0 build unpacks to 5.2 MiB) caps the sum of its entries; both are enforced by scripts/audit-zip.mjs after `npm run zip`.

budgets.description: Always-loaded selection observer; UI is injected separately on demand
Preact toolbar and artwork, injected only for the first qualifying selection
Explanation card, injected on the first Explain (Phase 5, D-08); not part of the observer
PDF reader startup JavaScript: entry chunk and every static import, including shared React and validation code; excludes dynamic PDF.js and UI imports
Side panel page JavaScript (Phase 8, FR-042): entry chunk and every static import, loaded when the user opens the panel
Toolbar (Preact) and explanation card static import closure, excluding chunks already loaded at reader startup; the baseline build measured 29,832 gzip bytes
PDF.js core, viewer components and worker, loaded when the first PDF is opened
PDF.js runtime data (CMaps, standard fonts, ICC profiles, wasm decoders), fetched on demand; sum of per-file gzip
Reader stylesheet (PDF.js viewer CSS plus the shell)
